caption: The drawing depicts two objects against a neutral, beige background that resembles textured paper. On the left is a garment resembling a tunic or dress with long sleeves and a fringed hem and sleeve edges. The garment is mostly tan or light brown, with a pink triangular collar or chest area, and a short blue horizontal line across the chest. There are blue vertical fringe-like decorations hanging down from the neckline, and the shoulders are adorned with small circular elements in pink. Several long, thin strips hang from the sleeves and lower portion of the garment. On the right side of the drawing is a rectangular piece of fabric or blanket, folded lengthwise with visible fringed edges. This fabric is primarily tan or beige in color, with a faint line of pink running parallel to the fringe on one side. The drawing is created with colored pencils or a similar medium, using subtle lines and shading to give form and texture to the objects.
title: Buckskin Shirt and Leggings
